summary: Stevanato Group S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, furnishing a press release of its first-quarter fiscal 2026 results. Revenue rose 7% (10% constant currency) to €273.6 million, adjusted EBITDA margin improved 150 bps to 23.9%, and diluted EPS was €0.10. The company maintained its full-year guidance of €1.26-1.29 billion in revenue and adjusted EPS of €0.59-0.63. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement — no special-situation transaction, board change, or strategic review is disclosed. The 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer's periodic report, analogous to a U.S. earnings press release.
